title: Tirisfal Glades
body: Tirisfal Glades was the heartland of the kingdom of Lordaeron, a country of misty woods, quiet farms and noble estates in the shadow of the royal capital. The Plague of Undeath struck it first and worst: so many died that mass graves were dug, and much of the population rose again for the Scourge. Now the glades belong to the Forsaken, who rule from the Undercity beneath the ruined capital and fight the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade at once.

title: Deathknell
body: In the hills of western Tirisfal lies Deathknell, where many of the Forsaken first open their eyes. The newly risen wake in the crypt above the village, and in the chapel below a shadow priest tells each confused arrival that the Dark Lady has freed them from the Lich King. Mindless dead, their former kin, still wander the northern streets.

title: Brill
body: Brill was a human town of the Lordaeron countryside and one of the first to fall to the Plague. Now it is the main Forsaken town of the glades, just north of the ruined capital, where the Deathguard plan their war on the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade, and apothecaries test their brews on the prisoners kept in the cellar of the Gallows' End Tavern.

title: Agamand Mills
body: Northwest of Brill, a cluster of windmills marks the Agamand Mills, once the seat of the wealthiest family in Tirisfal. When the Scourge came, the Agamands fortified their home and talked their workers into staying to defend it. The defense failed, and now the dead Agamands walk their own fields as servants of the Lich King.

parts.body: Thurman Agamand's last letter tells why the mills fell. His brother Devlin despaired and made a pact with the Scourge, murdered two watchmen and let the undead through a breach, and a third of the defenders died in the ambush.

title: Balnir Farmstead
body: The Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal once bred the white horses ridden by Lordaeron's royal household. Today the ruined farm shelters Scourge that slip past the Bulwark, and mages of the Undercity gather the snapdragons in its garden, flowers so receptive to magic that they show whether the taint of the Plaguelands has crept into the glades.

parts.body: Among the ruins a small grave marker bears the name of Invincible, the beloved steed of Prince Arthas Menethil, and wishes the loyal horse peace among clear streams and green pastures.

title: Venomweb Vale
body: Venomweb Vale in eastern Tirisfal was once a fine hunting ground for deer and rabbits; now it crawls with night web spiders whose venom the apothecaries prize. Old tales say the vale was a meeting place of the Council of Tirisfal, the secret order of mages that chose the Guardians of old, and that one of its members bred the spiders to guard it.

title: Whispering Gardens
body: The Whispering Gardens spread across the hill below the Scarlet Monastery, the great seat of the Scarlet Crusade. Long ago a fierce battle was fought here between a Scourge host and the forces that would become the Crusade, and it is said the spirits of the fallen still murmur in the twilight. Today Scarlet scouts and magicians guard the approach against all comers.

title: Ruins of Lordaeron
body: South of Brill rise the Ruins of Lordaeron, all that remains of the capital where King Terenas Menethil ruled. In its throne room the king was slain by his own son, Prince Arthas, and the Scourge laid the city waste. A grave in the ruins honors Terenas as the last true king of Lordaeron. Beneath lies the Undercity, reached by lifts at the back of the ruins.

parts.body: Of late the zeppelins beyond the walls carry the Forsaken across the sea to Vengeance Landing in the Howling Fjord, their foothold in Northrend.
After the Wrathgate the ruins became a war camp. With the city below held by traitors, the Horde massed among these broken walls, and Thrall and the Dark Lady came here to give the order to attack.

title: The Bulwark
body: The Bulwark guards the eastern edge of Tirisfal where the road enters the Western Plaguelands, the Forsaken's last line against the Scourge beyond. Here politics give way to a daily fight for survival, and members of the Argent Dawn, who call Horde and Alliance alike their friends in the war on evil, stand alongside the Forsaken.

parts.body: From here High Executor Derrington directs the Forsaken's war in the Western Plaguelands, against Andorhal and its plague cauldrons. Apothecary Dithers studies the plague beside him, and Alexi Barov, last of an old noble house, waits under guard.

title: Gunther Arcanus
body: Gunther Arcanus is the lich of Brightwater Lake, who keeps to his island northeast of Brill. He fell to the Plague but broke free of the Lich King and grew powerful in death; yet he believes every other undead is still the Scourge's slave, and sets his minions on all who come near. To the Forsaken, a free-willed lich is well worth winning over.

parts.body: In life he was a skilled necromancer who studied among the Kirin Tor with his friends Bethor Iceshard and Thule Ravenclaw. Gunther and Bethor fell to the Plague; Thule went over to the Scourge.
sources: quest 366 description (Kirin Tor students; both fell to the Plague)

parts.body: When the Scourge agent he set as a test falls, Gunther learns he is not the only undead with free will, and sends word to Bethor so that the two old friends can speak again.
